scope: Bounded static review of verified original nine assets, two mapped workers, eight LockScreen dependencies, and four mapped drawer dependencies. No client execution, account data or device access.

facts.fact: Known PN identity selects the per-user hashed preference. PermanentStorage.getItem synchronously reads localStorage on cache miss; JSON parsing is synchronous. No async hydration gate is required for this particular local preference. The raw getter preserves missing/null/string states; enabled getter defaults absence to zero and parseInt-coerces. Require raw numeric zero and enabled exactly false; missing or string zero fails.

CriticalDataSynced exact true comes from a distinct hydrated IndexedDB preference cache. It is useful readiness evidence but does not establish local lock-pref presence, freshness or mounted frontend lock state.

Removal awaits passcode-based Noise unwrap, key validation, rewrite without cached passcode wrapping, removal of lock salt/IV/iteration state, then a 400ms delay; only successful UI callback writes numeric zero. No default-zero initialization writer was found in reviewed modules.

Setup awaits lockNoiseInfo and 400ms delay before writing positive duration; there is an in-flight interval when the previous duration can still be zero. A retained interactive document can therefore have an enable operation pending despite raw zero.

Reviewed automatic timer rechecks duration !=0 at fire; keyboard and both logout upsells check enabled. Post-enable confirmation calls resolver without checking duration. Resolver itself is not gated. Current zero alone cannot rule out an already-started lock operation or stale confirmation callback.
Summary accepts numeric zero without mutation; an unknown nonzero timer value is normalized by writing a positive default. This is another reviewed writer, not a remote mutation.

The reviewed generic remote settings mapping enumerates app and per-chat preferences but contains no screen-lock duration/passcode setting. This bounds evidence to this mapping; it does not prove that every missing backend branch cannot affect local state.

Default getUser reads a cached value after first read. No general cross-document localStorage invalidation for lock settings was found; storage mutation outside the owned document must invalidate native eligibility or be excluded by exclusive store ownership.

eligibleCandidate: Fresh owned official-origin document with one exclusive profile/context; no official interactive settings or lock flow has occurred in this document
Known current PN identity internally, exact raw numeric duration zero and enabled exactly false
Reviewed main-ready, Stream MAIN, connected socket and critical-sync checks; account/document/generation checks before projection and after every awaited operation
Single native/official interactive owner. Opening official fallback clears native content before input is enabled; no concurrent hidden settings controls

Latch document ineligible after any lock/settings transition, official interaction, unknown gate, navigation, background, account change or storage-owner change; re-arm only through a fresh document and a newly satisfied gate
recommendation.reason: Fresh-document provenance excludes the concretely observed async setup and stale confirmation windows. It is a stronger lifecycle invariant than polling current preference values.
notEstablished: A complete catalogue of dynamic backend branches or remote lock mutations
Live current-version behavior or atomicity between JavaScript state and native display
Full native compatibility from static facts alone
recommendation.failClosed: Enabled, absent, malformed, string-zero, inherited interactive document, pending/unknown transition, unknown module/version or nonexclusive storage stays official. Do not set preference zero or request passcode/key material. This candidate requires independent source review plus synthetic lifecycle/race tests before any live activation.

backup.normalBrowserFinalSalt: Previously mapped WAWebHandleSuccess reads companion_enc_static from official success stanza and passes it to final-key generators.
backup.worm: No new consumer of getWormEarKey, worm_ear or WormEar was found in the four drawer dependencies. Existing key-store derivation is not a usage/schema mapping; full payload migration remains unresolved.
